findings.claim: Eight bullets, no proposed changes, no truncation, output below 600 tokens.
Host export list, preservation of user edits and hash-checked uninstall are supported.
All six ledger exports were omitted: parseSince, appendLedger, parseLedger, readLedger, summarizeLedger, renderLedgerText.
The summary misleadingly calls source-input reduction avoided paid tokens and omits Math.floor. The source explicitly disclaims measured cloud billing.
Only job/status counts are grouped by command/status; token and duration totals are global.

verification.ownershipClarification: verifyHostSkills derives ownership from a matching manifest entry; createdBy records origin. buildHostUninstallPlan additionally requires an unchanged hash. Current manually copied skills are not claimed by buildHostInstallStep.

accounting.ledgerFormula: For each entry with a valid timestamp in range and status in ['ok', 'dry_run', 'applied']: floor(max(0, toCount(entry.localInputChars) - toCount(entry.summaryChars)) / 3.5); sum per entry. estimatedPaidTokensAvoided is a legacy alias of estimatedInputTokensAvoided.
accounting.netEstimateFormula: floor(max(0, sourceChars - summaryChars - handoffPromptChars - envelopeCharsBeyondSummary - verificationReadChars - skillReadChars - preflightReadChars) / 3.5)
accounting.characterUnit: UTF-16 code units; decoded file content for source and skill; captured text for command reads

definitions.sourceChars: Sum of the two complete source lengths measured without returning their contents before delegation; agrees with this job's ledger.
definitions.summaryChars: Decoded returned summary; matches answerChars and this job's ledger.
definitions.handoffPromptChars: Entire exact ask command string, including the 203-character task, file arguments and flags.
definitions.envelopeCharsBeyondSummary: Captured JSON line length including newline (1624), minus decoded summary length (993); includes serialization overhead.
definitions.verificationReadChars: Two targeted source-read outputs, including file/line prefixes and newlines (15016), plus the selected job ledger record (233).
definitions.skillReadChars: Installed SKILL.md content read once; 6769 characters.
definitions.preflightReadChars: Initial inventory, tool discovery metadata, ancestor instructions/version/help, checkout metadata and five CLI preflight outputs. Read strings counted once, including duplicated human-readable/JSON payloads.

limitations: One successful command execution with a semantically partial summary; not evidence of fully usable summarization.
No retry, alternate runner, guard override, preference change, Unity process change or additional model job.
Character-based estimates are not tokenizer measurements, whole-session savings, cloud billing savings or currency; context caching and a matched baseline were not measured.

The net estimate includes the recorded reads and handoff, but excludes inherited conversation text, tool-call wrappers, commentary, evidence authoring and final evidence validation. Adding those costs cannot increase the zero estimate.
Platform tier labels are reported support metadata, not empirical validation of every command.
CLI-managed runtime records may be created by the requested commands; project file edits are limited to the two evidence artifacts.
